item.title: Spin-off Manga 'Puchimas!: Petit iDOLM@STER' Concludes 18-Year Serialization
item.description: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of the Dengeki Maoh magazine announced on Monday that the Puchimas!: Petit iDOLM@STER spin-off manga will end with its 200th and final chapter in the issue releasing on December 25. Akane began serializing the four-panel comedy manga, based on Bandai-Namco's The iDOLM@STER franchise, in Dengeki Maoh in July 2008.
